During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] technicians discovered the blueprints for an ancient '''machine''' designed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and successfully attempted to recreate it with modern materials.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Anomid Symposium}}</ref>
